info.title: PM3000 Modern Web UI REST API
info.description: Compact PM3000 API with PM3000-backed WebUI sessions, external bearer authentication, token administration, validated outlet/PDU inventory, fixed power actions, session-only password change, revision-protected Help and Language, Data Buffering, and conditional Appliance Logging and Time Zone settings, and read-only system information, memory/flash usage, network device monitoring, IPv4/IPv6 routing tables, and serial port statistics.

cookieAuth.name: pm3000_session
cookieAuth.description: Secure HttpOnly server-side WebUI session cookie. Browser mutations also require X-CSRF-Token.

OutletId.name: outletId
OutletId.description: Project-owned opaque identifier resolved only through the current inventory.
Base64url prefix of SHA-256 over the versioned backend row identity; collisions fail closed.

InventoryRevision.description: Opaque digest of the complete validated inventory used to detect stale action mappings.

availableActions.description: Clients may request on, off, or cycle only when independently authorized.

outlet.description: Opaque outlet ID or exact case-sensitive printable-ASCII outlet name. Names must resolve uniquely.

PduId.description: Domain-separated opaque identifier derived from the validated backend PDU row identity; collisions fail closed.

TokenRecordId.description: Opaque identifier for a token record; not a bearer credential.

TokenCreateRequest.description: Omit outlets for unrestricted outlet access. An empty array grants access to no outlets.

outlets.description: null means unrestricted; an empty array denies all outlets.
null means unrestricted; an empty array denies all outlets.

token.description: Returned exactly once. Never persisted in plaintext and never returned by list operations.

AcmeRenewalStatus.description: Closed safe diagnostics. Legacy state-only status remains valid; phase and reason appear together only for newly recorded failures.

AcmeBootstrapState.description: First-run projection. Directory URL and DNS names are intentionally absent until supplied by the operator.

StrongRevision.description: Quoted strong ETag revision derived from the complete validated setting and runtime choices.

applianceLanguage.description: Must exactly equal one of allowedLanguages from the fresh GET.

allowedDestinations.description: Runtime choices, validated by the adapter in firmware order: local, nfs, syslog, dsview.

ApplianceLoggingReplacement.description: Closed conditional union matching firmware omission semantics. Inactive descendant fields are forbidden and preserved from the fresh GET.

TimeZoneDstState.description: The runtime additionally rejects a DST start/end combination that the firmware validator treats as equal.

BadRequest.description: The JSON body is malformed, duplicated, or violates the closed schema.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The raw request body exceeds the operation's declared byte limit.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request is not unencoded UTF-8 application/json.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The path is known but the HTTP method is not allowed.

RevisionChanged.description: The If-Match revision does not match a fresh controller read; reload before saving.

PreconditionRequired.description: A quoted strong If-Match revision is required.

Outlet.description: One outlet resolved from the current inventory.

SessionCreated.description: Session created; the GSP SID remains server-side.

SessionCurrent.description: Public identity, CSRF token, rights-filtered navigation, and refreshed browser-session cookie.

SessionDeleted.description: Local session removed, controller logout confirmed, and browser-session cookie expired.

SessionBadRequest.description: The session request body is invalid.

SessionUnauthorized.description: Browser-session authorization was supplied or controller login/session validation failed.

SessionCsrfRejected.description: The browser-session CSRF token is missing or invalid.

SessionPayloadTooLarge.description: The session request body exceeds 1024 bytes.

SessionUnsupportedMediaType.description: The session request is not unencoded application/json.

SessionStoreUnavailable.description: Controller login succeeded, but the local server-side session could not be persisted safely.

LogoutIncomplete.description: Local session deletion or controller logout could not be confirmed. Set-Cookie is omitted when local deletion fails; the browser-session cookie is expired when local deletion succeeds but controller logout fails.

Unauthorized.description: A valid bearer token is required.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal lacks the required scope or outlet permission.

NotFound.description: The outlet identifier is not present in the current validated inventory.

BackendProtocolError.description: The backend returned missing, duplicate, ambiguous, oversized, or malformed data.

BackendUnavailable.description: The fixed controller operation could not complete. `backend_unavailable` hides internal transport/session details. `controller_service_user_unavailable` specifically means that the required local PM3000 account `pm3000-rest` is not configured and must be created with the required controller permissions.

ActionUnavailable.description: The fixed action could not be accepted. `action_outcome_unknown` means it may have been accepted and MUST NOT be retried automatically.

RenewalInProgress.description: A renewal already holds the fixed nonblocking renewal lock.

SettingWriteUnconfirmed.description: The pre-write backend read was unavailable (`backend_unavailable`), or a dispatched write could not be confirmed by exact typed read-back (`action_outcome_unknown`). A possibly dispatched write is never retried automatically.

TokenCollection.description: Non-secret token metadata; plaintext tokens and digests are omitted.

TokenCreated.description: Token created; plaintext bearer credential is returned exactly once.

LastAdministrator.description: The operation would remove the final enabled administrator.

example.message: The final enabled administrator cannot be disabled or revoked.

TokenLimitReached.description: The fixed token-record limit was reached.

example.message: No additional tokens can be created.

TokenStoreUnavailable.description: The token store could not be loaded or committed safely.

InventoryChanged.description: The submitted inventory revision is stale; refresh before retrying.

OutletSelectorConflict.description: The optional inventory revision is stale, or the supplied outlet name matches more than one outlet. Refresh inventory or use the opaque outlet ID.

ActiveSessionCookie.description: Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict active PM3000 browser-session cookie.

ExpiredSessionCookie.description: Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict PM3000 browser-session cookie expiration.

StrongETag.description: Strong revision for use as the next replacement request's If-Match value.
